title: Offline demo smoke scenario
description: One feature smoke test that is also the script for a narrated screen recording. The kit validates this shape by hand (demo_smoke/scenario.py); this schema is the documented reference and works with editors that understand JSON Schema draft-07.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema file.

name.description: Human name of the feature; used in the report title and in template narration.

slug.description: File-name-safe id used for final/<slug>.mp4. Defaults to a slugified name.

app_url.description: Base URL of the app under test. Relative `goto` paths are resolved against it.

viewport.description: Browser viewport (and the recorded frame size). Default 1920x1080.

login.description: How to authenticate before the first step. Default {"type": "none"}. Credentials are never stored in the scenario: form/basic logins read them from the named environment variables.

url.description: Login page path or absolute URL. Default: app_url.

username_env.description: Env var holding the user name, e.g. DEMO_USER.

password_env.description: Env var holding the password, e.g. DEMO_PASS.

success_selector.description: Optional selector that must appear after a successful login.

oneOf.description: HTTP basic auth sent with every request.

max_length_seconds.description: Target length of the final video. Narration is capped at max_length_seconds * 2.6 words; verify fails if the video is longer than this + 10 s.

intro.description: One or two sentences spoken over the first screen before any action. Max 45 words.

outro.description: One or two sentences spoken at the end while the last screen is held. Max 45 words.

steps.description: Ordered steps. Each step runs its actions, then checks its expectations; narration for the step is spoken while it runs.

id.description: Unique short id; used for screenshots (logs/step-NN-<id>.png), audio segments (audio/seg-<id>.wav) and narration ids.

title.description: Shown in the report; also seeds template narration ("Now I <title>").

narration.description: What is said during this step (first person, present tense, max 45 words). Used by narrate-template and as a hint for narrate-llm.

expect.description: All must hold (within timeout_s) for the step to PASS.

timeout_s.description: Budget for the whole step (actions + expectations).

action.description: Exactly one key naming the action.

goto.description: Path (resolved against app_url) or absolute URL to navigate to.

click.description: CSS/Playwright selector to move the cursor to and click.

fill.description: Set an input's value at once.

delay_ms.description: Per-keystroke delay so typing is visible on video.

type.description: Type text key by key (visible typing).

press.description: Keyboard key, e.g. Enter, Tab, Control+K.

files.description: File paths; relative paths are resolved against the scenario file's directory.

hover.description: Selector to move the cursor over.

y.description: Scroll the page vertically by this many pixels.

wait_for.description: Wait until a selector is visible or page text appears. The wait is recorded as a wait window that `edit` may speed up.

screenshot.description: Save an extra screenshot to logs/<name>.png.

expect.description: Exactly one of text / selector / url_contains / not_text.

text.description: Visible page text contains this string.

selector.description: At least one visible element matches.

contains.description: With selector: the matched element's text contains this.

count_min.description: With selector: at least this many matches.

url_contains.description: Current page URL contains this string.

not_text.description: Visible page text does NOT contain this string (e.g. an error banner).
